newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Vashisti Detergents issue fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: India's Vashisti Detergents issue fully subscribed.

text.p: Unilever's Indian subsidiary Hindustan Lever Ltd said its affiliate Vashisti Detergents Ltd completed a rights issue of shares, raising 514 million rupees.
Vashisti made the rights issue as part of a revival plan worked out for the firm, Hindustan Lever said in a statement.
The 1:1 rights was issued at 20 rupees per share.

"The Hindustan Lever group has fully subscribed to its rights entitlement," it said. The group, which held 21.8 percent of Vashisti's equity, has additionally acquired the 11.1 percent shareholding held by Maharashtra Petrochemicals Corp.

Lever said Vashisti would now proceed to complete its financial restructuring which envisages repayment of dues to financial institutions and augmentation of long-term working capital needs of the company.
Vasishti was set up by the erstwhile Tata Oil Mills Company Ltd and became a part of the Hindustan Lever group after Hindustan Lever acquired Tata Oil Mills Company last year.

Vashisti recently expanded its soaps and detergents capacity to 80,000 tonnes from 45,000 tonnes and has entered into a long-term sourcing arrangement with Hindustan Lever for supplying soaps and detergents, it said.
